round_1_findings.reason: The measured snapshot already has strong semantic readability, writable symbol axes, and carrier binding through k<=16, while dynamic codebook selection and cross-template transfer remain weak.
A second-order review found nonzero target information in display order despite marginal balance. Full display-order crossing and atom-triplet independence are required before causal-binding claims.

The 46 accepted atoms, centered/orthogonalized geometry, and L19/L21/L23 observations were measured on one gabliterated Qwen3.5-0.8B snapshot. The source checkpoint for the intended full fine-tune is still selected separately; hidden-state and tokenizer/atom admission must therefore be re-established at the exact selected checkpoint identity.

An unseen-symbol holdout is not established by merely declaring one. Exact atom identities must be assigned to immutable split-specific pools before tuning, and both target-token frequency and codebook-presence frequency must be audited.

Aggregate symbol accuracy can fail because semantic inference is wrong, because the target atom cannot be emitted, or because the episode-local mapping is not followed. Those failure classes must be measured separately before assigning binding/router credit.

All mapping-flip, semantic-flip, order-shuffle, polarity, lexical-paraphrase and nuisance variants derived from one latent case must carry one connected counterfactual family identity and remain atomic within a dataset split.

checkpoint_local_abi_gate.rule: Do not inherit the gabliterated snapshot's 46-atom admission, L19/L21 read references, L23 write hook, whitening basis, semantic subspace, or codec as positive labels for a different selected Qwen3.5-0.8B checkpoint.
required_after_checkpoint_selection: pin exact model revision, weights digest, tokenizer and runtime/build identity
re-tokenize every candidate atom and require observed one-token identity where one-token output is part of the protocol
re-run atom self-separation/cross-talk admission on the exact selected checkpoint if hidden-state atom geometry will be used
re-run semantic read-layer and symbol write-layer calibration if J-Space hooks will be used
derive a new checkpoint-local whitening/subspace/codec identity rather than reusing the measured gabliterated basis
bind every positive J-Space row to same-model causal receipts under the candidate-row gate
checkpoint_local_abi_gate.allowed_before_gate: Logical opaque symbols may be used in METHOD_ONLY source-design rows and deterministic generator tests only.

immutable_atom_pool_gate.rule: After checkpoint-local atom admission and before any tuning, freeze mutually disjoint TRAIN_ATOMS, VALIDATION_ATOMS, HOLDOUT_ATOMS and FINAL_UNTOUCHED_RESERVE pools by exact token/row identity and manifest digest.
constraints: No atom may occur in more than one pool.
Every materialized codebook triplet must draw only from its row split's atom pool.
Target atom frequency must be exactly balanced within each complete factorial block where divisibility permits.
Codebook-presence frequency must be balanced independently of target frequency.
Atom-triplet identity must be independent of semantic class, mapping ID, display order, template, polarity and lexical family.
Pool assignment is frozen before validation/holdout observation and may not be repaired from holdout results.

conditional_example_if_exactly_46_atoms_.note: 24/6/9 are divisible into three-atom codebook blocks; seven remain untouched. Recompute rather than forcing these counts if checkpoint-local admission produces a different usable atom count.

atomic_members: all six S3 mapping flips for the same latent semantic situation
all six codebook display-order variants when full order crossing is used
semantic-flip sibling cases derived from the same latent rule family
lexical paraphrases of the same latent case
counterfactual_component_gate.split_rule: The connected component induced by counterfactual_family_id plus provenance ancestry must belong to exactly one of TRAIN, VALIDATION or HOLDOUT. No sibling may cross a split boundary.

model_visible_redaction_gate.audit: Hash the final model-visible serialized prompt and target separately from evaluator metadata and verify that hidden metadata cannot be recovered from deterministic serializer ordering.

factorized_evaluation.purpose: Prevent aggregate output accuracy from being misreported as evidence for the learned binding/router mechanism.

metrics.definition: On a separately frozen evaluator, test whether the model resolves the latent semantic state correctly without requiring episode-local symbol lookup.
metrics.interpretation: Failure here is semantic inference failure, not sufficient evidence of a router failure.

metrics.definition: For each admitted target atom, directly request that exact atom under a frozen minimal emission protocol and measure exact single-token output.
metrics.interpretation: Failure here is symbol emission/write failure, not sufficient evidence of a mapping failure.

metrics.definition: Measure episode-local mapping accuracy on cases for which the corresponding semantic decision and direct target-atom write probes are both correct.
metrics.interpretation: This is the primary behavioral router metric; report its denominator and do not hide exclusions.

metrics.definition: Hold semantic situation and surface form fixed while changing only the realized mapping; output must change exactly to the newly mapped atom across the full S3 family.
Hold mapping and case fixed across all six codebook presentation orders; target and output should remain invariant.
For paired direct/inverted queries, known binary semantic states must transform as preregistered while unresolved state remains unresolved, then route through the same local mapping.
Evaluate mapping using atoms from HOLDOUT_ATOMS never present in TRAIN_ATOMS, after exact checkpoint-local tokenizer/ABI admission.
metrics.interpretation: Tests variable binding beyond memorized output atoms.

metrics.definition: Compare effect of semantic/mapping changes against model-visible nuisance changes such as order, neutral separators and distractors. Nuisance perturbations must not carry more target information or behavioral effect than the intended semantic/mapping manipulation.

error_attribution: WRITE_FAIL: semantic decision correct but target atom direct-write probe fails
ROUTER_FAIL: semantic decision and direct write correct but episode-local mapping output wrong
COMPOUND_FAIL: more than one prerequisite subsystem fails
PASS_BINDING: prerequisites pass and mapped output is correct
factorized_evaluation.promotion_rule: No positive J-Space or narrow-router causal credit from aggregate symbol accuracy alone. Behavioral binding gains require factorized metrics; J-Space causal credit additionally requires exact same-model intervention/lesion/shuffle/rescue evidence.

research_return.training_rule: Treat dynamic binding examples as connected causal counterfactual components with checkpoint-local output vocabulary, not as IID prompt/answer rows.
research_return.architecture_implication: The future Xeno harness should expose semantic decision, episode-local mapping lookup, and atom emission as separately auditable stages even if the deployed model implements them internally as one forward computation.
research_return.strong_falsifier: If semantic decisions and direct atom writes remain strong but conditional binding stays poor on unseen templates and unseen checkpoint-local atoms after fully factorial, leak-resistant training, the narrow-router hypothesis loses support. Broader contextual computation or architecture changes become more plausible.
research_return.anti_goodhart: Do not optimize aggregate symbol accuracy while semantic/write prerequisites degrade or shortcut MI remains nonzero. A higher scalar score can represent a worse binder if it exploits order/token/lexical priors.

next_exact_actions: After exact checkpoint selection, perform checkpoint-local tokenizer/atom/J-Space admission instead of inheriting the gabliterated snapshot ABI.
Freeze disjoint atom pools and counterfactual component assignments before tuning.
Upgrade the successor generator to full display-order crossing and explicit counterfactual_family_id propagation.
Add factorized semantic/write/router metrics to the frozen single-node and physical-GRID10 evaluation harness.
Keep training/provider execution closed under FREE_ONLY until separately authorized and admitted.
